messages:
maria: Heads-up — scheduled deploy tonight 02:00 UTC. We'll enable feature gate `llm_routing_v2` at 10% (slowstart) for 15m, then 50% for 30m if signals look good. Pinning route to model v3.2.1.

maria: Rollback criteria: sustained p50 latency > 150ms for 10m OR error rate > 1% (5m rolling). Also any model output regression on our smoke prompt set.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled by maria for 2024-05-15T02:00Z. Gate=llm_routing_v2, steps=[10%@0m, 50%@15m], pinned_model=v3.2.1. Run ID: db-1717001234. Use `/deploy cancel db-1717001234` to abort.

jamal: quick q — are we also pinning KV-cache schema? if session cache changes, we should avoid cross-traffic.

maria: yes — cache schema v2 is locked for the rollout. traffic routed to compatible hosts only.

alex: will watch token-level costs and p50. I can follow telemetry on the console route dashboard.

lina: note: we have the EU region maintenance window at 03:00 UTC. keep an eye on region routing.

sre-oncall: SRE checks — we'll trigger a soft-hold if p50 > 150ms for 5m to let you inspect. Escalate to oncall if it doesn't recover in 10m. Also set circuit backoff to fallback model `v3.2.1-q4` on errors.

maria: got it. Can we add an auto-drain to 0% on 2xx->5xx ratio > 2x for 3m?

sre-oncall: yes. deploy-bot will perform an automatic drain to 0% if error ratio threshold is met. I'll also have dashboards pre-open.

deploy-bot: db-1717001234: starting rollout -> 10%.

deploy-bot: db-1717001234: step complete: 10% @ +3m. Metrics snapshot: p50=120ms, p95=320ms, errors=0.4% (3m avg).

alex: saw a small p95 blip at +2m (cached warmups). p50 steady. no adverse signals on cost.

jamal: outputs on smoke set looked fine. sample: "Context-aware routing OK" (no hallucinations).

maria: proceeding to 50% in 10m if no regressions. I'll annotate release notes with model pin and rollback thresholds.

lina: tagging support rotation FYI: @support-team will get an automated note at 50% rollout.

deploy-bot: db-1717001234: scheduled step -> 50% @ +15m.

maria: if anyone sees anything urgent: @sre-oncall, @jamal, ping me directly. otherwise will post final status at +45m. :shipit:
